Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-01
DOC-0040 2026-10-14
MEETING NOTES — Weekend Cabin Coverage and the
Side-Question Margin
Date: 2026-10-14
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
Attendees: PERSON-0001 for TEAM-0001; weekend roster clerk;
cabin documentation coordinator; program chair.
Purpose: Plan DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA's cabin desk contacts for the
coming weekend. ISSUE-0103 and TASK-0274 locate the planning
folder.
Decisions
Reserve cabin contact appointments at 10:40 on 2026-10-17 and
2026-10-18. The roster clerk will seek a named receiving
coordinator for each appointment and return an unresolved
coverage question to the program chair. The appointment diary
must distinguish a requested interval from confirmed
attendance.
Use a question parking margin for background matters that
would otherwise interrupt the coverage decision. Every parked
question retains its addressee and promised reply date. The
central paragraph remains the place for the coverage
arrangement and the next action required to secure it.
The documentation coordinator will keep the paper-delivery
appointment separate from the receiving person's availability.
A delivery plan cannot establish that somebody will be at the
cabin desk to receive the discussion.
Action items
- Owner: Weekend roster clerk. Due: 2026-10-16. Seek the
receiving coordinators and report any remaining coverage
question.
D. Worker 0001
Demo Worker 0001, Demo Team 01
